subStrands.name: Whole Numbers
content: Reading and writing numbers in symbols and in words

outcomes.text: use place value and total value of digits up to tens of thousands in daily life situations
read and write numbers up to 10,000 in symbols in real-life situations
read and write numbers up to 1,000 in words in day-to-day activities
order numbers up to 1,000 in different situations
round off numbers up to 1,000 to the nearest ten in different situations
identify factors of numbers upto 50 in different contexts
identify multiples of numbers up to100 in different situations
apply even and odd numbers up to 100 in different situations
make patterns involving even and odd numbers in real-life situations
represent Hindu Arabic numerals using Roman numerals up to ‘X’ in different situations
appreciate use of whole numbers in real-life situations

learningExperiences: share tasks in identifying place value of numbers up to tens of thousands using place value apparatus and other resources
jointly work with others to identify total values of digits up to ten thousand
read numbers up to10,000 in symbols
team up with peers to read and write numbers up to 1,000 in words froma number chart or other resources
work with peers and arrange numbers up to 1,000 from smallest to largest and largest to smallest using number cards and share with others
team up with peers to round off numbers up to 1,000 to the nearest ten and share with others
jointly work with peers to identify factors/divisors of numbers up to 50 and share with others
team up with peers to identify multiples of numbers up to 100 and share with others
jointly work with peers to identify even and odd numbers up to 100 and share them with others
team up with peers to use number cards to make patterns involving even and odd numbers
jointly with peers write Hindu Arabic numerals using Roman numerals up to ‘X’ using number charts
team up with peers to use digital devices to play digital games involving whole numbers
keyInquiryQuestions: What should you consider when writing numbersin words?
Why should we determine the place value of a digit in a number?
coreCompetencies: Critical thinking and problem solving: learner uses place value apparatus to identify place value of numbers up to tens of thousands.
Learning to learn: learner rounds off numbers up to 1,000 to the nearest ten and share experiences with others.
values: Respect: learner takes turn to represent Hindu Arabic numerals using Roman numerals up to ‘X’ using number charts.
Unity: learner works amicably with peers to identify multiples of numbers up to 100 and share with others.
pcis: Social Cohesion: learner works harmoniously with others in identifying factors/divisors of numbers up to 50.
links: The learner is able to relate rounding off numbers up to 1,000 to the nearest ten to rounding off distances on a map in Social Studies.
